This eco hamper consists of a selection of high-quality, plantable, reusable, and biodegradable stationery items. Each element is made with sustainable raw materials, making it ideal for eco-conscious brands, NGOs, educational institutions, HR teams, and green event planners.

  • Cork Sticky Notes – Made from natural cork material, these sticky notes offer an eco-friendly alternative to conventional plastic-based sticky pads.
  • Plantable Pen & Pencil Set (4+4) – Includes four plantable pens and four plantable pencils. Each contains seeds at the end, allowing users to grow a plant after use.
  • Mini Grow (GIY Kit) – A compact “Grow-it-Yourself” kit with soil, seeds, and a biodegradable pot. Creates a fun planting experience for recipients.

  • Jute Basket Box (8″x8″x5″) – A stylish, reusable, and biodegradable jute box that enhances the natural appeal of the eco gift hamper.
